thread:
maria: heads up — planning a staggered v2 rollout tomorrow 09:00 UTC. main ask: preserve v1 contract for a 72h grace period while we monitor telemetry.
sam: +1. do we have a concrete header flag for client opt-in? we should avoid implicit switches.
lee: client-sdk already added support for `X-RW-API-Prefer: v2` in 0.8.4, but most mobile apps are still on 0.8.1. we should publish clear migration notes.
ryan: oncall here — what are rollback triggers? latency > 2x baseline? error spikes > 3sigma? need concrete SLOs.
maria: rollback criteria: 1) sustained 2x median p95 for 15m; 2) 5%+ increase in 5xx rate for 10m; 3) any regression in core reranking metrics from eval set (auto-alert).
sam: thanks. deploy plan: stage 1 enable header flag at edge (no auto-route). stage 2 traffic mirror v2 for 2h. stage 3 gradual 5/10/25/50% if signals ok. stage 4 flip default for new tokens after 72h.
deploybot: scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rb-1748881234, window=09:00-12:00 UTC, shards=5. See /deploy rb-1748881234 status.
lee: note — we must keep the v1 content-type and sequence behavior identical. if v2 changes message framing, clients without header must still get v1 behavior.
maria: yes. we'll enable a compatibility shim in gateway that does header-based behavior and a passthrough for legacy clients. config snippet: ```yaml
gateway:
  compat_mode: "v1-preserve"
  opt_in_header: "X-RW-API-Prefer"
  rollout_window: 72h
```
ryan: can we add a short-circuit to revert header routing server-side if we see tenant-level anomalies? sometimes single tenant causes problems.
sam: will add tenant-level blacklist to the rollout job. command to add: `/deploy blacklist add <tenant-id> --job rb-1748881234`
lee: publishing release notes now: short migration guide + code samples for Swift/Android + server-side header fallback example. I’ll ping docs once draft is ready.
maria: ops checklist: 1) preflight telemetry dashboard up, 2) health hooks for eval suite, 3) run chaos test on canary for connection resets, 4) docs and SDK alerts.
deploybot: preflight checks passed for job rb-1748881234: infra OK, canary pool healthy, quota checked. to start: `/deploy start rb-1748881234`
ryan: I'll be on watch from +1h before start until +4h after. set pager policy to high for the job.
sam: reminder — do not flip default until mobile SDKs report 50% upgrade or we hit 72h. we'll run a brief post-deploy eval at 30m and 3h.
maria: perfect. if anything looks off we hit `/deploy abort rb-1748881234` and roll back header routing. :thumbsup:
lee: thanks — posting a short note to #release-notes with migration snippet and mobile callouts.
maria: closing — morning stand will confirm final go/no-go at 08:30 UTC.
